mentions.name: Bebril
mentions.description: A quest-based self-improvement app where you state who you want to become and are given mini quests that help you progress toward that goal, designed as a choose-your-own-adventure that feels rewarding for taking action.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2. Bebril - https://www.bebril.com

This project is a fun one where you to state who you want to become and you are given mini quests to take that help you on your path to get there. I want it to be a choose your own adventure where you feel rewarded for action.
